headline: Zuck's Insta 📸💥 Goes on Trial 🎭😭 for Kid Privacy 📜🔒
text: 30 STATES 🏛️🇺🇸 are SUING 💼🔨 Meta's Zuck Empire 🕴️💰 to FORCE 🚫 massive OVERHAUL 🔄 of Insta 📷 and FB 📘 for the YOUTH 👶🧒. Trial kicks off TUESDAY 📅, biggest test yet for the BOSS 👑 of social media. States want $1 TRILLION 💰💸 from Zuck and DEMAND changes like ENDING like counts 👍🚫, killing infinite scroll 🌀🛑, and parental CHECKS 🔐 for teens. Kentucky AG Russell Coleman 🗣️🔥 says, 'We'll show a jury that Meta HID 👀 what it knew about the HARM 😭 its products cause young people, because LOOKING AWAY was more PROFITABLE 💵!' States also want to BAN 📛 autoplay 🎥, multiple accounts 👥🚫, disappearing posts 🕒💨, and all those DOPAMINE-manipulating ALGOS 🧠🎰. Former Meta exec turned WHISTLEBLOWER Kelly Stonelake 🗣️🕵️‍♀️ warns of COGNITIVE DISSONANCE 🧠💥 at the top. Kaley, a young girl who WON 🏆 her case, testified she created DOZENS of accounts to chase LIKES 😔📈, ending up depressed at age TEN. Research links like counts to REJECTION 😩 and LONELINESS 🥀. Judge Biedscheid in New Mexico already FINED Meta $942M 💸 and called it a PUBLIC NUISANCE 🏭☢️, ordering similar changes. If these states win, Meta's platforms could be TOTALLY TRANSFORMED across the US 🇺🇸. Campaigners are CELEBRATING 🎉 as this could be the biggest CONSUMER PROTECTION case in history 📜🏆. Zuck's empire is facing its TOUGHEST FIGHT yet 🤼‍♂️💥!
